worldboss.beyondsolo.titan.title: the Walking Mountain
worldboss.beyondsolo.behemoth.title: the Horned Calamity
worldboss.beyondsolo.stillness.title: Monarch of Stillness
worldboss.beyondsolo.hunger.title: Monarch of Hunger

worldboss.beyondsolo.stillness.domain.hi: Everything slows here, and what stays too long freezes
worldboss.beyondsolo.stillness.authority: Get out of the circle before it closes
worldboss.beyondsolo.hunger.domain.hint: Your food drains and your wounds bleed
worldboss.beyondsolo.hunger.authority.hi: Every hunter near is marked: keep moving
worldboss.beyondsolo.storms.domain.hint: Lightning falls here: watch the ground
worldboss.beyondsolo.storms.authority.hi: Every other square is struck, then the rest: keep moving
worldboss.beyondsolo.notify.risen: %s has risen %s. The System calls every hunter to the hunt.
worldboss.beyondsolo.notify.descent: A gate is tearing open in the sky %2$s. %1$s comes down through it in %3$s s.
worldboss.beyondsolo.notify.ascended: %s has gone back through its gate. No hunter stood against it to the end.
worldboss.beyondsolo.notify.sank: %s has sunk back into the earth. No hunter stood against it to the end.
worldboss.beyondsolo.banner.gate: A gate tears open in the sky
quest.beyondsolo.world_boss.desc: %s walks the world. Every hunter who fights it to the end is rewarded by their share of the damage.
quest.beyondsolo.world_boss.monarch.desc: %s has come down from beyond the gates. It can be beaten, and what a monarch leaves behind, nothing else does.
item.beyondsolo.monarch_seal.desc: Break it in the overworld: the gate it holds shut tears open in the sky, and a monarch comes down through it.
item.beyondsolo.monarch_seal.overworld: The seal only breaks under the open sky of the overworld.
item.beyondsolo.monarch_seal.busy: Another great threat walks the world: the seal holds.
item.beyondsolo.monarch_seal.no_room: There is no open land near you for a monarch to come down on.
tooltip.beyondsolo.set_source.monarch: Monarch: only a slain monarch leaves it
perk.beyondsolo.monarch_stillness.desc: your blows slow what they strike, and every fifth one freezes it in place
perk.beyondsolo.monarch_hunger.desc: every kill gives back 12% of your health and feeds your strength, up to three times (8 s)
perk.beyondsolo.monarch_storms.desc: every fourth blow calls lightning down on your foe, and it leaps to two more
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.titan: A giant of basalt and magma that carries a mountain ridge on its back. It wakes under the land where hunters grow strong, and the earth splits when it walks. When it is wounded deep enough, its skin runs molten.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.behemot: A beast the size of a house with four great horns and a back of bone plates. It marks the ground before it charges, and nothing in its path stays standing. Its blood calls a pack to its side.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.monarch: A queen of ice with a crystal spear, come down through a tear in the sky. Where she rules, every heartbeat slows and the air itself stops. Her last authority is a cold that ends all motion.
A feral king in a wolf's skull with blades for claws. He is never full: the longer he hunts, the faster he moves, and within his domain everything starves. His feast leaves nothing behind.
A winged lord in storm-dark plate with a glaive of lightning. He calls the sky down on whoever stands before him, and passes judgment on the land square by square.
title.beyondsolo.colossus_breaker.desc: Have a share in felling a world boss.
title.beyondsolo.crownbreaker.desc: Have a share in slaying a monarch.
title.beyondsolo.throne_taker.desc: Do the most damage to a monarch that falls.
